headlines.title: Trump holds historic meeting with Xi and Putin
headlines.description: President Trump took part in historic three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in China. NBC News' Garrett Haake has the details.

headlines.title: National cyber director to leave Trump administration
headlines.description: A White House official says Sean Cairncross will leave his position as National Cyber Director. The news comes as the country has been dealing with a series of tech outages. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

headlines.title: Celebrity hippo Fiona dies
headlines.description: Zoo announcing today Fiona has died after ingesting a knit hat that accidentally landed in her habitat. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports.

headlines.title: Flash flood rescues on both coasts
headlines.description: Record rainfall is occurring across much of Florida and neighborhoods are underwater. It’s occurring during what’s normally the dry season for the state, while an atmospheric river is pelting California. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: For the Washington Spirit, will the third time be the charm in the NWSL championship?
headlines.description: The Washington Spirit hope the third time will be the charm as they face the Kansas City Current at home in the National Women’s Soccer League championship Saturday.

headlines.title: Senate passes bill simplifying permitting rules to build in America, sending it to House
headlines.description: The Senate voted 62-33 on Thursday night to pass a sweeping bill to simplify and overhaul permitting rules for energy and infrastructure projects.

headlines.title: Justice Department seeks dismissal of its lawsuit in Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: The Trump administration had sought to block certification of the election results if Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan lost. Democrat Mary Peltola won the race.

headlines.title: White House national cyber director is leaving the administration after series of tech outages
headlines.description: Sean Cairncross has played a key role in crafting AI policy for the Trump administration. His immediate replacement is Kirsten A. Davies.

headlines.title: Walmart stocks up on inflation-weary shoppers ahead of the holidays
headlines.description: Walmart raised its sales outlook and reported gaining market share as it lures more affluent shoppers who are hunting for deals amid high inflation.

headlines.title: Early Black Friday deals are here, and I’m tracking the 57+ best ones daily: Amazon, Apple, PlayStation and more
headlines.description: Early Black Friday deals are here from Amazon, Apple, Walmart, Target, PlayStation and more. Follow daily updates as our shopping experts find the best sales.

headlines.title: Talking Shop with comedian Heather McMahan
headlines.description: Comedian Heather McMahan is going on tour in 2027. She’s not traveling without her favorite packing cubes, snacks, lashes and compression socks.
